asian.reason: Fast-casual average delivery menu premium, 12.6% (Gordon Haskett, 2020); no Asian-cuisine measure found. Same value on dd/ue/gh: no platform-specific menu-only figure published.

burger.reason: McDonald's food-only menu prices on delivery apps are 19.3% above in-store (Self Financial, prices of 1 Apr 2025, blended across apps). Same value on dd/ue/gh: the study gives no per-app food-only split.

casual.reason: Casual-dining average delivery menu premium, about 3% (Gordon Haskett via Restaurant Dive, 2020). Same value on dd/ue/gh: no platform-specific menu-only figure published.

chicken.reason: Fast-food average delivery menu premium, 15.3% (Gordon Haskett, Jul 2020). Chick-fil-A at 29.8% is the highest outlier of 25 chains, so not used as typical. Same value on dd/ue/gh: no platform split published.

coffee.reason: Starbucks delivery menu premium, 20.3% (Gordon Haskett, Jul 2020); single chain used as the coffee proxy. Same value on dd/ue/gh: no platform split published.

dessert.reason: Fast-food average delivery menu premium, 15.3% (Gordon Haskett, Jul 2020); no dessert-specific measure found. Same value on dd/ue/gh: no platform split published.

mexican.reason: Fast-casual average delivery menu premium, 12.6% (Gordon Haskett, 2020). Chipotle's 21% premium (Credit Suisse via Restaurant Business) is one chain, so not used. Same value on dd/ue/gh: no platform split published.

other.reason: Fallback for unmatched fast-food brands: fast-food average delivery menu premium, 15.3% (Gordon Haskett, Jul 2020). Same value on dd/ue/gh: no platform split published.

pizza.reason: Fast-food average delivery menu premium, 15.3% (Gordon Haskett, Jul 2020). Orchestrator override 2026-11-12: the only pizza-specific figure is one chain (Papa John's: third-party menu equals first-party, Credit Suisse), and applying a single chain's parity to every unprofiled pizza place would understate app costs. Same value on dd/ue/gh: no platform split published.

sandwich.reason: Quick-service sandwich proxy: fast-food average delivery menu premium, 15.3% (Gordon Haskett, Jul 2020); no sandwich-specific measure found. Same value on dd/ue/gh.
